# SocQ Agent Integration Guide

Base REST URL: https://api.socq.ai
Hosted MCP URL: https://api.socq.ai/mcp
Authentication: Authorization: Bearer SOCQ_API_KEY

SocQ exposes a machine-readable Capability Registry at `/v1/catalog`. It contains endpoint IDs, JSON Schema input definitions, normalized output schemas, current billing, availability, documentation links, and generated MCP tool names.

The default MCP connection exposes compact discovery and execution tools. Add `?platforms=youtube,tiktok` to load typed tools for at most five platforms, or `?tools=youtube_comments,x_search` for at most thirty exact tools. Do not combine both filters.

Collection is asynchronous. Submit a request, retain its task ID, and poll until `succeeded` or `failed`. MCP can wait at most 30 seconds per submit call. Request `view=standard` for a fixed, provider-independent resource schema whose declared nullable fields remain present. V1 REST defaults to the compatible `full` view. `fields` supports at most 50 comma-separated top-level or dot-path fields and is valid only with `standard`. Follow `next_cursor` for additional result pages and use the task files endpoint for complete source exports.

CLI examples:

  socq platforms
  socq tools youtube
  socq describe youtube/comments
  socq youtube comments --urls URL --wait
  socq task results TASK_ID --format jsonl --output result.jsonl

Use an idempotency key when retrying a submission after a transport failure. For 24 hours, reusing the key with identical input returns the original task; changing input produces a conflict. Unfinished tasks remain protected until they finish.

See https://docs.socq.ai/llms.json for the complete generated endpoint catalog.

# Snapchat APIs

## Get Snapchat Profiles

Fetch normalized profiles data from Snapchat.

- REST: POST /v1/snapchat/profile
- MCP: socq_snapchat_profile
- CLI: socq snapchat profile

## Get Snapchat Spotlights

Fetch normalized spotlights data from Snapchat.

- REST: POST /v1/snapchat/spotlight
- MCP: socq_snapchat_spotlight
- CLI: socq snapchat spotlight

## Get Snapchat Spotlight Comments

Fetch normalized spotlight comments data from Snapchat.

- REST: POST /v1/snapchat/spotlight-comments
- MCP: socq_snapchat_spotlight_comments
- CLI: socq snapchat spotlight-comments

<!-- input-contracts:start -->
## Input requirements

- `facebook/pages`: Provide public Facebook page/profile URLs in urls. Keyword search, username-only input, and individual post/reel URLs are not supported. Legacy query and usernames fields are ignored when valid urls are supplied.
- `facebook/posts`: Provide public Facebook page/profile URLs in urls. Keyword search, username-only input, and individual post/reel URLs are not supported. Legacy query and usernames fields are ignored when valid urls are supplied.
- `facebook/reels`: Provide Facebook page/profile URLs to collect their reels. A single /reel/... video URL is not a profile URL.
- `instagram/followers-count`: Provide usernames or public Instagram profile URLs. query is ignored and cannot be used as the only input.
- `instagram/reels`: Provide usernames or public Instagram profile URLs. query is ignored and cannot be used as the only input.
- `instagram/search`: query is required and accepts keywords, not task instructions. Separate multiple terms with commas; punctuation such as @, #, quotes, periods, slashes and hyphens is unsupported. results_limit is 1 to 250. urls and usernames are deprecated and ignored.
- `seo/keyword-difficulty`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/keyword-overview`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/keyword-search-volume`: Use language values supported by Keyword Search Volume: Chinese uses zh_CN or zh_TW, not zh. Locale support differs between SEO endpoints.
- `seo/keyword-suggestions`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/keywords-for-site`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/ranked-keywords`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/related-keywords`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/relevant-pages`: Choose a supported country and a language available in that country. The defaults are United States (2840) and English (en). Country code 2156 is unavailable here. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `seo/search-intent`: Use the language codes declared for this endpoint. Locale support differs from Keyword Search Volume and live SERP.
- `tiktok-shop/product`: This endpoint currently supports US only. Omit region or set it to US; other regions are rejected before task creation.
- `tiktok-shop/user-showcase`: This endpoint currently supports US only. Omit region or set it to US; other regions are rejected before task creation. results_limit must be 20 to 2000.

Explicit no-posts responses from instagram/hashtag-posts and linkedin/search-posts complete with empty results; other failures are preserved.
<!-- input-contracts:end -->

# Song charts, discovery and community APIs

## TikTok Popular Songs

Get songs from the TikTok app Top 50 or Viral 50 chart.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/popular-songs
- MCP: socq_tiktok_popular_songs
- CLI: socq tiktok popular-songs
- Billing: Per returned result

Get the TikTok app Top 50 or Viral 50 songs chart. chart_type defaults to top; choose viral for Viral 50. results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts integers from 1 to 50. Optionally provide callback_url to receive a task completion notification.

## TikTok Top Search

Search public TikTok videos and photo carousels.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/top-search
- MCP: socq_tiktok_top_search
- CLI: socq tiktok top-search
- Billing: Per returned result

query is required. results_limit defaults to 100. Results can contain videos and photo carousels; region changes content availability and does not guarantee geographic filtering.

## TikTok User Live

Check public TikTok accounts for live streaming status, including offline results.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/user-live
- MCP: socq_tiktok_user_live
- CLI: socq tiktok user-live
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide a non-empty usernames array. Each successful lookup returns one billable status, including is_live=false for offline accounts.

## X Community

Get public X community metadata, member counts, rules and membership policies.

- REST: POST /v1/x/community
- MCP: socq_x_community
- CLI: socq x community
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide public X community URLs in urls, using /i/communities/{numeric_id}.

## X Community Posts

Collect public posts from X communities in creation-time order.

- REST: POST /v1/x/community-posts
- MCP: socq_x_community_posts
- CLI: socq x community-posts
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide public X community URLs in urls. results_limit applies to each URL, defaults to 100, and must be a multiple of 20 between 20 and 2000.

## X Thread Context

Collect the target X post, its ancestors and replies while preserving thread relationships.

- REST: POST /v1/x/thread-context
- MCP: socq_x_thread_context
- CLI: socq x thread-context
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide X post URLs in urls. results_limit applies to each URL, defaults to 100, and accepts integers from 1 to 2000. Results retain the target post and its thread relationships.

# Instagram stories, engagement and location APIs

## Instagram Stories

Collect the stories a public Instagram account has live now.

- REST: POST /v1/instagram/stories
- MCP: socq_instagram_stories
- CLI: socq instagram stories
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide a public Instagram username. Returns the stories the account currently has live; each story stays available for 24 hours after posting.

## Instagram Similar Accounts

Collect accounts Instagram suggests as similar to a public account.

- REST: POST /v1/instagram/similar-users
- MCP: socq_instagram_similar_users
- CLI: socq instagram similar-users
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide a public Instagram username. Returns the accounts Instagram suggests as similar to it; results_limit sets how many to return (default 50, up to 100).

## Instagram Comment Replies

Collect replies to a public Instagram comment.

- REST: POST /v1/instagram/comment-replies
- MCP: socq_instagram_comment_replies
- CLI: socq instagram comment-replies
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide the post, reel or IGTV url and the comment_id of the comment whose replies you want; results_limit sets how many replies to return (default 100, up to 1000).

## Instagram Post Likers

Collect public accounts from an Instagram post likers list.

- REST: POST /v1/instagram/post-likers
- MCP: socq_instagram_post_likers
- CLI: socq instagram post-likers
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide a public post, reel or IGTV url. Returns the accounts shown in the post's likers list; results_limit sets how many to return (default 100, up to 1000).

## Instagram Location Search

Search Instagram locations by name or coordinates.

- REST: POST /v1/instagram/location-search
- MCP: socq_instagram_location_search
- CLI: socq instagram location-search

Search by place name with query, or by a point on the map with latitude and longitude. Coordinate search returns the places around that point.

## Instagram Location Info

Collect details of a public Instagram location.

- REST: POST /v1/instagram/location-info
- MCP: socq_instagram_location_info
- CLI: socq instagram location-info

Identify the location with either location_id or its location page url.

## Instagram Location Posts

Collect public posts tagged at an Instagram location.

- REST: POST /v1/instagram/location-posts
- MCP: socq_instagram_location_posts
- CLI: socq instagram location-posts
- Billing: Per returned result

Identify the location with either location_id or its location page url. Set sort_by to top (default) for the location's top posts or recent for the newest posts; results_limit sets how many posts to return (default 20, up to 100).

## Instagram Hashtag Search

Search Instagram hashtags by keyword.

- REST: POST /v1/instagram/search-hashtags
- MCP: socq_instagram_search_hashtags
- CLI: socq instagram search-hashtags
- Billing: Per returned result

Provide one keyword in query; a leading # is optional. results_limit sets how many hashtags to return (default 50, up to 100).

# YouTube trending, community, search and contact APIs

## YouTube Trending Shorts

Collect Shorts that are trending on YouTube right now.

- REST: POST /v1/youtube/trending-shorts
- MCP: socq_youtube_trending_shorts
- CLI: socq youtube trending-shorts
- Billing: Per returned result

Every field is optional. results_limit sets how many Shorts to return (default 48, up to 200); each run samples what is trending at that moment.

## YouTube Community Post

Collect the text, images and likes of one YouTube community post.

- REST: POST /v1/youtube/community-post
- MCP: socq_youtube_community_post
- CLI: socq youtube community-post

Pass the post link in url, either a /post/{post_id} link or a channel Posts link with ?lb={post_id}.

## YouTube Community Post Comments

Collect comments on a YouTube community post.

- REST: POST /v1/youtube/community-post-comments
- MCP: socq_youtube_community_post_comments
- CLI: socq youtube community-post-comments
- Billing: Per returned result

url is the community post link. results_limit defaults to 100 and accepts 1 to 1000.

## YouTube Related Videos

Collect the videos YouTube recommends next to a video.

- REST: POST /v1/youtube/related-videos
- MCP: socq_youtube_related_videos
- CLI: socq youtube related-videos
- Billing: Per returned result

url takes a watch, youtu.be, Shorts or live link; one run returns the full recommendation list, usually about 20 videos.

## YouTube Channel Search

Search YouTube channels by keyword.

- REST: POST /v1/youtube/search-channels
- MCP: socq_youtube_search_channels
- CLI: socq youtube search-channels
- Billing: Per returned result

query is required. results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts 1 to 200.

## YouTube Shorts Search

Search YouTube Shorts by keyword.

- REST: POST /v1/youtube/search-shorts
- MCP: socq_youtube_search_shorts
- CLI: socq youtube search-shorts
- Billing: Per returned result

query is required. results_limit defaults to 25 and accepts 1 to 200. Each result carries the Short's link, caption, view count and thumbnail.

## YouTube Search Suggestions

Collect the autocomplete suggestions YouTube offers for a search.

- REST: POST /v1/youtube/search-suggestions
- MCP: socq_youtube_search_suggestions
- CLI: socq youtube search-suggestions

query is required; language (default en) and region (default US) pick the market. Billed once per request.

## YouTube Email Finder

Find public contact emails for a YouTube channel.

- REST: POST /v1/youtube/channel-email
- MCP: socq_youtube_channel_email
- CLI: socq youtube channel-email
- Billing: Per returned result

url is a channel link in the @handle or /channel/UC... form. A channel with a public email returns one result listing every address and its source pages; a channel without one returns an empty result at no charge.

# TikTok audience, discovery, LIVE and video analytics APIs

## TikTok Audience Demographics

Collect the countries a TikTok account's followers are located in.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/user-audience
- MCP: socq_tiktok_user_audience
- CLI: socq tiktok user-audience

username is required. One result per account lists its follower countries with their share of the audience, largest first. Billed once per request.

## TikTok Similar Accounts

Collect accounts TikTok recommends as similar to a TikTok account.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/similar-users
- MCP: socq_tiktok_similar_users
- CLI: socq tiktok similar-users
- Billing: Per returned result

username is required. results_limit defaults to 30 and accepts 1 to 300.

## TikTok Reposts

Collect the videos a TikTok account has reposted.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/user-reposts
- MCP: socq_tiktok_user_reposts
- CLI: socq tiktok user-reposts
- Billing: Per returned result

username is required. Reposts arrive newest first; results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts 1 to 500.

## TikTok Playlists

Collect the public playlists of a TikTok account.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/user-playlists
- MCP: socq_tiktok_user_playlists
- CLI: socq tiktok user-playlists
- Billing: Per returned result

username is required. Each playlist comes with its name, cover and video count; results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts 1 to 100.

## TikTok Hashtag Views

Collect the video and view counts of TikTok hashtags.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/hashtag-detail
- MCP: socq_tiktok_hashtag_detail
- CLI: socq tiktok hashtag-detail
- Billing: Per returned result

hashtags takes 1 to 20 names; each existing hashtag returns one result and missing ones are skipped.

## TikTok Sound Search

Search TikTok sounds by keyword.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/search-music
- MCP: socq_tiktok_search_music
- CLI: socq tiktok search-music
- Billing: Per returned result

query is required; sort_by picks relevance, most_used or latest, and region picks the market (default US).

## TikTok Live Search

Search TikTok LIVE streams broadcasting now by keyword.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/search-live
- MCP: socq_tiktok_search_live
- CLI: socq tiktok search-live
- Billing: Per returned result

query is required. Each result's id and author.id are the room_id and user_id for TikTok Live Shopping.

## TikTok Photo Search

Search TikTok photo carousel posts by keyword.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/search-photos
- MCP: socq_tiktok_search_photos
- CLI: socq tiktok search-photos
- Billing: Per returned result

query is required. Every result includes all images of the carousel; results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts 1 to 500.

## TikTok Trending Searches

Collect today's trending search keywords on TikTok.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/trending-keywords
- MCP: socq_tiktok_trending_keywords
- CLI: socq tiktok trending-keywords

Takes no input and returns about 100 ranked searches. Billed once per request.

## TikTok Creator Search Insights

Collect popular TikTok searches with their popularity trend.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/search-insights
- MCP: socq_tiktok_search_insights
- CLI: socq tiktok search-insights

language, category and filter_by (all or content_gap) are optional. Returns 20 searches with popularity scores and seven-point trends, billed once per request.

## TikTok Live Ranking

Collect the TikTok LIVE daily creator ranking.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/live-ranking
- MCP: socq_tiktok_live_ranking
- CLI: socq tiktok live-ranking

Takes no input and returns up to 99 ranked creators with their scores. Billed once per request.

## TikTok Live Shopping

Collect the products in a TikTok LIVE stream's shopping bag.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/live-products
- MCP: socq_tiktok_live_products
- CLI: socq tiktok live-products
- Billing: Per returned result

room_id and user_id come from TikTok Live Search. results_limit defaults to 100 and accepts 1 to 500.

## TikTok Fake Views Checker

Estimate how much of a TikTok video's view count is inauthentic.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/fake-views
- MCP: socq_tiktok_fake_views
- CLI: socq tiktok fake-views

url is required; category tunes the engagement benchmarks. Returns one analysis, billed once per request.

## TikTok Comment Keywords

Collect the keywords that come up most in a TikTok video's comments.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok/comment-keywords
- MCP: socq_tiktok_comment_keywords
- CLI: socq tiktok comment-keywords

url is required. Returns ranked keywords, each with the comments that mention it, billed once per request.

# TikTok Creative Center APIs

## TikTok Creative Center Top Ads

Collect top-performing TikTok ads from TikTok Creative Center.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok-creative-center/top-ads
- MCP: socq_tiktok_creative_center_top_ads
- CLI: socq tiktok-creative-center top-ads
- Billing: Per returned result

All fields are optional: query, time_range (7d, 30d or 180d) and sort_by (relevance or likes). results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts 1 to 300.

## TikTok Creative Center Ad Analysis

Collect the details and second-by-second performance curves of a TikTok top ad.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok-creative-center/ad-analysis
- MCP: socq_tiktok_creative_center_ad_analysis
- CLI: socq tiktok-creative-center ad-analysis

ad_id comes from TikTok Creative Center Top Ads. Returns click-through and retention curves plus an impressions percentile, billed once per request.

## TikTok Creative Center Trending Hashtags

Collect the hashtags trending on TikTok in a country.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok-creative-center/trending-hashtags
- MCP: socq_tiktok_creative_center_trending_hashtags
- CLI: socq tiktok-creative-center trending-hashtags
- Billing: Per returned result

country (default US) and time_range (7d, 30d or 90d) choose the ranking; results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts 1 to 100.

## TikTok Creative Center Hashtag Insights

Collect the popularity curve and top countries of a trending TikTok hashtag.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok-creative-center/trending-hashtag-detail
- MCP: socq_tiktok_creative_center_trending_hashtag_detail
- CLI: socq tiktok-creative-center trending-hashtag-detail

hashtag_id comes from TikTok Creative Center Trending Hashtags; use the same country. Billed once per request.

## TikTok Creative Center Top Videos

Collect the chart of top-performing TikTok videos in a country.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok-creative-center/top-videos
- MCP: socq_tiktok_creative_center_top_videos
- CLI: socq tiktok-creative-center top-videos
- Billing: Per returned result

country, period (daily, weekly or long_term) and sort_by are optional; the latest published chart is used. results_limit defaults to 20 and accepts 1 to 100.

## TikTok Creative Center Creator Marketplace

Collect TikTok Creator Marketplace cards with audience demographics and rates.

- REST: POST /v1/tiktok-creative-center/creator-cards
- MCP: socq_tiktok_creative_center_creator_cards
- CLI: socq tiktok-creative-center creator-cards
- Billing: Per returned result

creator_ids takes 1 to 20 Creator Marketplace IDs, such as creator_id values from TikTok Creative Center Top Videos.
